# PG001 — TypeAdapter constructed inside a function

## Cause

A `TypeAdapter(...)` is built inside a function or method body. Each
instantiation constructs a new validator and serializer, so a `TypeAdapter` in
a function is rebuilt on every call (`pydantic/concepts/performance.md:37-64`).

## Fix

Build the `TypeAdapter` once at module scope and reuse it.

```python
# Before — PG001
def parse(raw):
    return TypeAdapter(list[int]).validate_python(raw)


# After — no violation
adapter = TypeAdapter(list[int])  # module scope, built once


def parse(raw):
    return adapter.validate_python(raw)
```

## Suppression

Suppress with `# noqa: PG001` on the construction line when a per-call adapter
is intentional (e.g. the type is only known inside the function).
